name: Steal A Fish
desc:
🐟 Collect powerful fish and earn Money!
🧠 Defend your house from other players!
👣 Sneak into enemy bases and steal their Fish!

🎭 Welcome to Steal a Fish 🎭

[How to Play]
• Buy fish that appear through the tunnel
• Add them to your collection to generate Money
• Visit other players to see their fish stash
• Steal rare fish and dominate the leaderboard!
